cards.ex: Could you give me a lift to the station, please? I'm running late.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, meni vokzalga eltib qo'ya olasizmi? Kechikayapman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirdan mashinada bir joyga eltib qo'yishni so'rash.

cards.ex: The constant delays at the airport are really starting to take their toll on my nerves.
cards.exUz: Aeroportdagi doimiy kechikishlar asabimga jiddiy zarar yetkaza boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan yomon ta'sir ko'rsatmoq, zarar keltirmoq.

cards.ex: We finally got the all-clear to board the plane after the security check.
cards.exUz: Nihoyat, xavfsizlik tekshiruvidan so'ng samolyotga chiqishga ruxsat oldik.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga rasmiy ruxsat, odatda xavfsizlik bilan bog'liq.

cards.ex: The city was in complete gridlock after the snowstorm.
cards.exUz: Qor bo'roni shaharni butunlay tiqilinch holatiga keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Transport harakati butunlay to'xtab qolgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: With a new CEO at the helm, the airline is hoping to improve its customer service.
cards.exUz: Yangi bosh direktor boshqaruvda bo'lgani uchun, aviakompaniya mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishni yaxshilashga umid qilmoqda.

cards.ex: The new suspension system in the car made for a really smooth ride.
cards.exUz: Mashinaning yangi osma tizimi haqiqatan ham oson sayohatni ta'minladi.

cards.ex: The pilot realized they were slightly off course due to the strong winds.
cards.exUz: Uchuvchi kuchli shamol tufayli biroz yo'ldan adashganliklarini angladi.

cards.ex: People get really annoyed when others try to jump the queue at the taxi rank.
cards.exUz: Odamlar taksi turargohida boshqalar navbatsiz o'tishga harakat qilsa, juda jahli chiqadi.

cards.ex: Traffic was bumper-to-bumper for miles on the motorway.
cards.exUz: Avtomagistralda mashinalar bir necha kilometrga mashina-mashinaga bo'lib qoldi.

cards.ex: We decided to ferry across to the island instead of flying.
cards.exUz: Biz orolga uchib borish o'rniga paromda o'tishga qaror qildik.

cards.ex: We made good time on the journey, arriving an hour earlier than expected.
cards.exUz: Biz sayohatda yaxshi vaqt sarfladik va kutilganidan bir soat oldin yetib keldik.
cards.uzDef: Tez vaqt ichida bir joyga yetib borish.

cards.ex: The airline was pretty much flying by the seat of its pants during the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Aviakompaniya pandemiya davrida asosan tajribasiga tayanib harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy reja yoki tayyorgarliksiz, instinktga tayanib harakat qilish.

cards.ex: My luggage got lost while in transit between flights.
cards.exUz: Mening yukim reyslar orasida yo'lda yo'qolib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir joydan boshqa joyga ko'chib o'tish jarayonida.

cards.ex: New high-speed rail lines are on the horizon, which will transform travel.
cards.exUz: Yangi yuqori tezlikdagi temir yo'l liniyalari yaqinlashib kelmoqda, bu sayohatni o'zgartiradi.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada sodir bo'lishi kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: Let's call a cab; it's too far to walk in this weather.
cards.exUz: Taksi chaqiramiz; bu ob-havoda piyoda yurish juda uzoq.

cards.ex: Traffic came to a standstill after the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan so'ng transport harakati to'xtab qoldi.

cards.ex: I always call dibs on riding shotgun when we go on road trips.
cards.exUz: Sayohatga chiqqanimizda har doim old o'rindiqni band qilaman.

cards.ex: As soon as we arrived at the airport, we made a beeline for the information desk.
cards.exUz: Aeroportga kelganimiz zahoti, ma'lumot stolidan to'g'ri o'tdik.

cards.ex: The city is running a pilot project to test electric buses.
cards.exUz: Shahar elektr avtobuslarni sinab ko'rish uchun sinov loyihasini amalga oshirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yangi tizimni yoki g'oyani sinab ko'rish uchun kichik miqyosdagi loyiha.

cards.ex: Lots of companies are jumping on the bandwagon and developing electric cars.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab kompaniyalar trendga ergashib, elektr mashinalarni ishlab chiqmoqda.

cards.ex: The plane was finally clear for takeoff after a long delay.
cards.exUz: Samolyot uzoq kechikishdan so'ng nihoyat uchishga ruxsat oldi.
cards.uzDef: Samolyotga uchish uchun rasmiy ruxsat berilgani.

cards.ex: We had to take a detour because of roadworks.
cards.exUz: Yo'l ishlari tufayli aylanma yo'ldan borishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy yo'ldan chetga chiqib, aylanma yo'l bilan borish.

cards.ex: My brother is such a backseat driver; it's really annoying when he tells me how to drive.
cards.exUz: Ukam haydovchiga maslahat berishni yaxshi ko'radi; u qanday haydashni aytganda, bu juda asabiylashadi.

cards.ex: They travelled around Europe on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Ular Yevropa bo'ylab juda kam xarajat bilan sayohat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan, tejamkorlik bilan.

cards.ex: The train was going full throttle across the countryside.
cards.exUz: Poyezd qishloq bo'ylab to'liq quvvat bilan harakatlanayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Maksimal tezlikda yoki kuch bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: If you don't book your tickets soon, you'll miss the boat.
cards.exUz: Agar siz chiptalaringizni tez orada buyurtma qilmasangiz, imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy berasiz.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get my bearings in the new city.
cards.exUz: Yangi shaharda yo'nalishimni aniqlash uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.

cards.ex: We need to put the pedal to the metal if we're going to make it on time.
cards.exUz: Agar vaqtida yetib borishni istasak, gazni bosishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: After the argument, we needed to clear the air before continuing our trip.
cards.exUz: Bahsdan so'ng, sayohatni davom ettirishdan oldin vaziyatni aniqlashtirishimiz kerak edi.

cards.ex: The train service is finally back on track after the delays.
cards.exUz: Poyezd xizmati kechikishlardan so'ng nihoyat yo'liga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi holatga qaytish, normal holatga kelish.
